verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a password manager, but the pack documents no user-definable rule or trigger engine. The CLI only lets external scripts and CI/CD pipelines retrieve and manage items, which is a developer building block. Pass Monitor raises fixed security alerts, which is an adjacent feature. Neither lets a user define rules that fire actions automatically on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
